## 🗓️ Weekly Readings & Student Leaders

Each week, the assigned **Student Leader** will select **one** paper for the class to read and critique by Thursday of the prior week.

| Week | Topic | Paper Option (Classic / Modern) | Student Leader |
|:-----------------|:-----------------|:-----------------|:-----------------|
| **3** | Exchangeability, Positivity, Consistency | Holland (1986) / Hernán (2018) | GA |
| **4** | Confounding & Selection Bias | Hernán et al. (2004) / Cole & Hernán (2002) | DB |
| **5** | Propensity Scores | Rosenbaum & Rubin (1983) / Austin (2011) | CB |
| **6** | IPTW & Marginal Structural Models | Robins et al. (2000) / Cole & Hernán (2008) | CG |
| **7** | G-computation & TMLE | Robins (1986) / Petersen & van der Laan (2014) | AK |
| **8** | Instrumental Variables | Angrist (1990) / Angrist & Pischke (2010) | EK |
| **9** | Effect Modification & Interaction | Rothman (1974) / VanderWeele (2019) | EL |
| **10** | Mediation I (Foundations) | Baron & Kenny (1986) / Imai et al. (2010) | GM |
| **11** | Mediation II & Principal Stratification | Robins & Greenland (1992) / Daniel et al. (2015) | KMG |
| **12** | Sensitivity Analysis | Rosenbaum (1987) / VanderWeele & Ding (2017) | MS |
| **13** | Target Trial Emulation | Robins (1987) / Hernán et al. (2008) | HZ |

## 🎓 Roles & Responsibilities

#### 🧑‍🏫 Discussion Leader

1.  **Submit Paper Choice:** Email your selected paper to the instructor by **Thursday of the week prior** to your assigned week.
2.  **Post Discussion Starter:** Post your discussion starter in the weekly Canvas thread by **Sunday at 11:59 pm**. It must include:
    -   A \~300-word summary of the paper.
    -   Your answers to the three guiding questions from the [Weekly Readings Schedule](readings/weekly_paper_critique_schedule.qmd).
    -   A key takeaway from the paper.
3.  **Lead In-Class Discussion:** Be prepared to lead the in-class discussion on Tuesday.

#### ✍️ All Other Students

1.  **Read:** Read the paper selected by the Discussion Leader.
2.  **Post Critique:** Post your critique in the weekly Canvas thread by **Monday at 11:59 pm**. It must include:
    -   A brief summary of the paper.
    -   Your answers to the three guiding questions from the [Weekly Readings Schedule](readings/weekly_paper_critique_schedule.qmd).
    -   A personal takeaway from the paper.
